name: @usdk/driver-voice
description: Browser-local capability-voice driver, backed by the Web Speech API (SpeechRecognition/SpeechSynthesis). IMPORTANT: in Chrome-family browsers, SpeechRecognition typically sends microphone audio to a cloud speech-to-text service - this is NOT offline, and this package does not claim otherwise anywhere (see the README and docs/UAGENT_ARCHITECTURE.md 'Voice, accessibility, and conversation'). Browser-only: importing this module outside a browser (no window.SpeechRecognition) makes isAvailable() return false rather than throwing, so a host can fail over to the text-only path.
